newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICAN CURRIE CUP RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICAN CURRIE CUP RESULTS.

text.p: Results of South
African Currie Cup matches played over the weekend:
In Welkom (on Friday):
Northern Free State 31 Eastern Province 18 (halftime 11-13)
Scorers:
Northern Free State - Tries: Jurie Jurling (2), Willie
Nagel, Koos Heydenrich. Conversion: Eric Herbert. Penalties:
Herbert (3).
Eastern Province - Tries: Deon Kayser, Chad Alcock.
Conversion: Theo van Rensburg. Penalties: Van Rensburg (2).
In Brakpan (on Friday):
Gauteng Falcons 39 North West 31 (27-11)
Scorers:
Gauteng Falcons - Tries: Len van Riet (2), Eugene Meyer,
Naas Rossouw, Wikus Lock. Conversions: Jaco Viljoen (3), Jacques
Blaauw. Penalties: Viljoen (2).
North West - Tries: Tony Lincoln, AJ de Jager, Reagan
Anderson, Chris Oosthuizen. Conversion: Bertus Kruger.
Penalties: Kruger (3)
In Wellington (on Saturday):
Gauteng Lions 35 Boland 33 (13-20)
Scorers:
Gauteng Lions - Tries: Hennie le Roux, Dawie du Toit, Johan
Roux, penalty try. Conversions: Dawie du Toit (3). Penalties: Du
Toit (3).
Boland - Tries: Jan Ackermann, Harold Karele, Marius Goosen.
Conversions: Pieter O'Neill (3). Penalties: O'Neill (4)
In Durban (on Sunday):
Natal 34 Western Province 22 (12-8)
Scorers:
Natal - Tries: Jeremy Thomson, Errol Stewart, Ollie le Roux.
Conversions: Gavin Lawless, Hans Scriba. Penalties: Lawless (5).
Western Province - Tries: Andrew Aitken, Garry Pagel, Andy
Marinos. Conversions: Louis Koen (2). Penalty: Koen.
Note: Gauteng Falcons formerly Eastern Transvaal, North West
formerly Western Transvaal and Gauten Lions formerly Transvaal.
